summary: Represent Fetch request/response bodies as Web ReadableStream-backed bodies with backpressure, cancellation, locking, teeing, and disturbed state preserved.

semantics.body: ReadableStream<Uint8Array> or null at the JS surface
semantics.cancel: stream cancellation must propagate to fetch/body source
semantics.tee: clone creates branches with Streams semantics
semantics.backpressure: must not be replaced by eager whole-body buffering when observable

tests.name: response body is readable stream
tests.input: const r=new Response("x"); console.log(r.body instanceof ReadableStream);

tests.name: locked body is unusable for clone
tests.input: const r=new Response("x"); const rd=r.body.getReader(); try { r.clone(); } catch(e) { console.log(e.name); } rd.releaseLock();
